Shep S3 (nudge calibration — tone tier): the nudge output records the tone tier used (gentle reminder vs escalation) or the overdue signal that selects it. Presence proxy for the calibration decision; the correctness of the chosen tier is judged by the S3 Tier 3 grade.

Shep S3 (nudge calibration, >= 90% tone-tier match): whether the nudge's tone matches the required tier is a semantic judgment only Tier 3 grading can make. Honest alternative — grade presence at B or better; defers (skipped) until graded.
